scope: SSE/SZSE main-board frozen Snapshot V1, evaluated at T EOD
ordinary_reference: previous valid raw trading close on the same security; requires qualified ordinary-day status before formal admission
special_reference_policy: UNRESOLVED unless an independently qualified canonical exchange reference price is available; none is available in Snapshot V1
exception_policy: even an ordinary mechanical hit remains UNRESOLVED until independent dated evidence excludes other no-limit exceptions
d8_policy: OUTCOME_ONLY_NEVER_SIGNAL; D8 may be joined only in a separate post-hoc quality audit, never as a reference or candidate/signal input
historical_risk_policy: old 5% regime can be excluded by a V3 price path only when tick-rounded 10% upper is strictly above tick-rounded 5% upper, and other exceptions are independently excluded
limitation: the ordinary label is a screen based on available PIT fields, not a market-wide official exception-clearance certificate
